guidance.purpose: Build a browser interface with React and Vite's development/build tools.
guidance.when: Choose this when your project needs an interactive browser UI.
guidance.unnecessary: A server-only API does not need React.
guidance.prerequisites: Node 24 and pnpm; TypeScript starter in this catalog.
guidance.alternatives: Express or FastAPI serve APIs rather than browser components.
guidance.impact: Scaffolds a new application and installs its dependencies; create only.

guidance.purpose: Handle HTTP requests in a Node.js API.
guidance.when: Choose this when a JavaScript/TypeScript backend needs routes.
guidance.unnecessary: A browser-only application does not need a separate API server.
guidance.example: A route returning a task list as JSON.
guidance.prerequisites: Node 24 and pnpm; TypeScript starter in this catalog.
guidance.alternatives: FastAPI is the Python API journey.
guidance.impact: Creates API source, package scripts, and TypeScript configuration; create only.

guidance.purpose: Build a Python HTTP API using type-based request models.
guidance.when: Choose this when your backend uses Python.
guidance.unnecessary: A browser-only interface does not need an API framework.
guidance.example: An endpoint returning a health response.
guidance.prerequisites: Python 3.12/3.13 and uv 0.12.17; install prerequisites yourself.
guidance.alternatives: Express is the TypeScript API journey.
guidance.impact: Initializes a Python project and creates API source; create only.

guidance.purpose: Validate untrusted values against an explicit schema.
guidance.when: Add it when form or API input needs runtime checks.
guidance.unnecessary: Skip it when you have no input boundary to validate yet.
guidance.example: Reject a task title that is not a string.
guidance.alternatives: Existing explicit validation; Pydantic for Python.
guidance.impact: Adds the Zod dependency; write your own schemas.

guidance.purpose: Run repeatable assertions to catch regressions.
guidance.when: Add it when application behavior needs automated tests.
guidance.unnecessary: Skip a second test runner if your current one already meets your needs.
guidance.example: Assert an API health response or a small React helper.
guidance.prerequisites: A supported Node application and Node 24.
guidance.impact: Adds dev dependencies, a config, a test script, and context-specific samples. Existing files/scripts are preserved on add.

guidance.when: Add it when manual style decisions slow you down.
guidance.unnecessary: Skip it if your project already has a formatter you want to keep.
guidance.alternatives: Keep an existing formatter; Ruff for Python.
guidance.impact: Adds a dev dependency, .prettierrc, and .prettierignore. Existing target files are preserved on add.

guidance.purpose: Define Python data models with validation.
guidance.when: Use it when Python input needs explicit data shapes.
guidance.unnecessary: FastAPI already brings Pydantic; a separate selection is often unnecessary.
guidance.example: Validate the fields of an API request model.
guidance.alternatives: Existing manual validation; Zod for TypeScript.
guidance.impact: Declares the Pydantic dependency; creates no custom models.

guidance.purpose: Run Python assertions as an automated test suite.
guidance.when: Add it when API behavior needs regression checks.
guidance.unnecessary: Skip a second runner when your existing test suite is sufficient.
guidance.example: Assert the generated FastAPI endpoint response.
guidance.alternatives: Keep an existing Python test runner.
guidance.impact: Adds pytest and the recipe's FastAPI test dependencies/sample; preserves existing sample files on add.

guidance.purpose: Check Python source for lint issues and format it.
guidance.when: Add it when you need consistent Python checks.
guidance.unnecessary: Skip it when an existing linter/formatter covers your needs.
guidance.example: Find an unused import before review.
guidance.alternatives: Keep your current Python lint/format tools.
guidance.impact: Adds the Ruff dependency; run checks deliberately.
